name: ScriptSprint
tagline: Turns meeting and voice transcripts into summary, speakers and action items
description: Pulls transcripts from sources like Otter, whether voice memos, meetings or rants, and distills each into its speakers, a clean summary and the action items hiding inside. The output lands on a companion note in an Obsidian-style vault, with the original transcript left exactly as it was.
author: the_simonjester
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
